records.subject: ART
records.title: Introduction to Art
records.description: For non-majors. Appreciation of various visual art forms; emphasis on contemporary period.

records.subject: ART
records.title: 2D Art and Design
records.description: Introduction to two-dimensional art and design through an interdisciplinary approach using a combination of manual methods, digital imaging technologies, and machine tools.

records.subject: ART
records.title: 3D Art and Design
records.description: Introduction to three-dimensional art and design through an interdisciplinary approach using a combination of manual methods, digital imaging technologies, and machine tools.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Drawing
records.description: Composition in pictorial space, visualization of ideas, drawing from life.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Figure Drawing
records.description: Introduction to drawing the human figure.

records.subject: ART
records.title: World Art History I
records.description: Art and architecture of Western and Non-Western cultures from approximately 3000 BCE to 1300 CE.

records.subject: ART
records.title: World Art History II
records.description: Art and architecture of Western and Non-Western cultures from 1300 to 2010.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Engaged Art: Making Connections and Communities
records.description: Practice-driven exploration of the relationship between collective art-making and civic engagement; open to any major in the Humanities with special emphasis on visual culture.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Arts of Native North America
records.description: Diversity of visual forms, traditional and contemporary, within changing historical and cultural contexts.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Arts of Asia
records.description: Art and architecture of India, China and Japan within their historical, religious and cultural contexts. (Crosslisted course offered as ART 302, ASIA 302.)

records.subject: ART
records.title: Modern Art-19th Century
records.description: History of 19th century art in Europe and the United States.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Modern Art-20th Century
records.description: Modern art in the 20th century.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Arts of Ancient Greece and Rome
records.description: The arts of ancient Greece, Etruria, and Rome from the Greek Dark Ages to the early Christian era.

records.subject: ART
records.title: A History of Collecting and Museums
records.description: An exploration of the history of museums and collecting as dynamic processes with a fundamental goal of contextualizing the presence of the past for the beholder.

records.subject: ART
records.title: The Arts of Renaissance Europe
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: ART 202 or concurrent enrollment.
records.description: The arts of southern and northern Europe from 1300 to 1550.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Women Artists I
records.description: Women artists of the Middle Ages through the 18th century. (Crosslisted course offered as ART 308, WGSS 308.)

records.subject: ART
records.title: Experiencing Ancient Making
records.description: Investigating ancient objects, representations of objects, and their makers, including movement of objects and production process issues.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Women Artists II
records.description: Women artists of the 19th to 20th century. (Crosslisted course offered as ART 310, WGSS 310.)

records.subject: ART
records.title: Seminar in Visual Literacy
records.description: Discussion of content, impact, purpose, audience, and ownership of visual messages, including topics such as synesthesia, AI images, reality TV, deep fakes, mockumentaries, phenomenology, semiotics, hallucinations, optical illusions, maps, advertising, infographics, Op Art, iconography, iconoclasms, cultural bias and blind spots, political cartoons, police body cams, and musical notation.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Advanced Drawing
records.description: Advanced projects using drawing media and process.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Drawing from the Body
records.description: Continuation of FINE ART 111. Contemporary discourse surrounding the body; exploration through the practice of drawing and performative actions.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Beginning Painting
records.description: Introduction to problems in painting; development of composition and color.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Intermediate Painting
records.description: Problems and ideas in painting.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Art, Science, and Technology
records.description: Survey of art's relationship to science and technology from Renaissance to present day; emphasis on historical overview and cultural implications.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Introduction to Digital Art and Design - Print and Screen
records.description: Introduction to principles and processes of digital media through print/screen-based projects; emphasis on image/text relationships, color, composition.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Introduction to Digital Media - Video, Sound, and Animation
records.description: Principles and processes of digital media through video, 2D animation and sound-based projects; theoretical investigations and conceptual development.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Introduction to Typography
records.description: Translating design concepts into typographic form and expression; exploring the interplay of type form and meaning with projects and daily challenges; communicating ideas about typography critically and fluently.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Experimental Animation
records.description: Digital and analog animation techniques; conceptual development of narrative structures. (Crosslisted course offered as ENGLISH 337, ART 337.)

records.subject: ART
records.title: Ceramics
records.description: Hand building processes; glazing; firing.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Sculpture
records.description: Composition of form in the three-dimensional space.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Intermediate Sculpture
records.description: May be repeated for credit; cumulative maximum 9 hours.

records.subject: ART
records.title: 3D Modeling and Studio Fabrication
records.description: Introduction to 2D and 3D digital fabrication techniques with software and hardware including 3D printers, scanners, laser cutters, and CNC machines; integration of technologies with traditional fabrication methods.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Illustration
records.description: Exploring the intersection of visual art and narrative by learning how to use illustration skills to tell stories; developing skills in visual communication to create meaningful conversations and discover a personal visual language.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Introduction to Printmaking
records.description: Introduction to the fundamentals of printmaking, incorporating drawing, painting and collage; processes may include lithography, etching, relief and monotype.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Screen Printing
records.description: Introduction to the basic techniques, processes and history of screen printing for art and design.

records.subject: ART
records.title: History of Photography
records.description: Historical survey of photography from its invention to the present; conceptual, cultural, and technical implications of the medium.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Beginning Photography
records.description:
Fundamentals in lens-based media (photography) tools and techniques, in conjunction with image capture, editing, printing, and display; formal, conceptual, expressive,
and aesthetic concepts explored.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Intermediate Photography
records.description: Expansion of conceptual and technical development with photography including location and studio lighting and camera techniques; research and portfolio development.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Sketchbook, Creative Ideation
records.description: Explores strategies for documenting, synergizing, and maintaining creative ideas, including collecting information, brainstorming, and mind-mapping to aid creative integration; no drawing experience required, and drawing will not be the main subject of instruction.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Modern Theories of Art
records.description: Selected topics in 19th and 20th century theories of art.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Advanced Non-western Art History
records.description: Different topics related to the arts in Africa the Americas, Oceania, and Asia.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Contemporary Art: Theory and Practice
records.description: Contemporary theories of art and how those theories are developed.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Art History Thesis
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Admitted to the major in Fine Arts, with an Art History option; junior standing.
records.description: Thesis directed by student's department; original research paper regarding visual culture using art historical research skills.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Advanced Painting
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: ART 321; admitted to the major in Fine Arts.
records.description: Continuation of FINE ART 321. Advanced problems in painting. Six credits only with permission of instructor.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Design for Print
records.description: Principles and processes of visual communication in digital print; may include typography, image/text relationships, layout design and book arts.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Time Based Media
records.description: Principles and processes of video, installation, and sound based art; emphasis on conceptual development of experimental forms.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Interactive Media
records.description: Interactive possibilities in digital media; may include web-based projects, installation, creative coding, AR/VR, and physical computing.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Material and Performance
records.description: Studio-based class providing understanding of contemporary issues related to fiber materials and performance.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Advanced Sculpture
records.description: Six credits only with permission of instructor.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Advanced Printmaking
records.description: Survey of digital and photo processes for printmaking.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Advanced Photography
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: ART 382; admitted to the major in Fine Arts.
records.description: Advanced studio art techniques and development; research of historic and contemporary photographic trends; discussion of personal direction.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Gallery Procedures with Museum of Art
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Permission of the Museum of Art.
records.description: Introduction to art museums and galleries, including practicum in exhibition preparation, installation, art handling, collections.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Senior Exhibit
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Admitted to the BFA major.
records.description: Independent study involving exhibit, written thesis and oral examination working with area coordinator.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Fine Arts Internship
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Admitted to the major in Fine Arts.
records.description: Experience in work-related fine arts environments for practical application and experience.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Contemporary Issues Seminar
records.description: Research seminar examining current issues confronting art and artists; students learn how to develop their professional art career.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: ART
records.title: Special Problems
records.description: Independent study conducted under the jurisdiction of an approving faculty member; may include independent research studies in technical or specialized problems; selection and analysis of specified readings; development of a creative project; or field experiences.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.
